publication.publisher_or_container: Simon Millanges / Jean Richer (Bordeaux/Paris); modern editions widely available
publication.edition: First edition; 'Au lecteur' / 'To the Reader' front matter

verification.verification_notes: Confirmed first publication March 1580 and the 'To the Reader' preface. Verified the conversational/informal style (learned vocabulary mixed with popular sayings) and direct reader address. Public domain; only the technique is described, no text reproduced.

limitations: Individual English translations vary in register; warmth is partly carried by the Middle French 'Au lecteur' whose intimacy is approximated in translation.

copyright.notes: Original 1580 text is public domain; modern translations may be copyrighted and are not reproduced.
